integrity: All finite-sample identities have an analytic proof; enumerated rational checks corroborate but do not prove statements for all sample sizes. Historical priority remains qualified.
limitations: Independent and identically distributed real observations, symmetric about a fixed known zero, zero atom absent, and a finite positive fourth moment. Strict conditional-variance ordering requires nonconstant positive magnitude. This does not assert stochastic ordering, a new test, or historical uniqueness.
title: Sign-imbalance ordering of sample scatter under symmetric sampling
